Imagine you are riding your bike up a really steep hill. It’s hard work, right? Your legs feel heavy, and you’re moving super slowly. Now, imagine you’re going down a hill. You’re zooming past trees and wind in your ears!

A bicycle gear system is like a set of **magic levers** that help your legs do the right amount of work for the situation. It changes how hard you have to push on the pedals and how fast the bike moves.
